sources.title: Don't mess with yordles | An in-depth Tristana Guide!

passive.name: Draw a Bead
passive.text: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.text: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

spells.name: Rocket Jump
spells.text: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

spells.name: Explosive Charge
spells.text: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

spells.name: Buster Shot
spells.text: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

damage.value: Tristana deals burst Magic Damage with Buster Shot and sustained weapon damage during Rapid Fire.

archetype.value: Tristana is an ADC with an aggressive playstyle built around burst and reset mechanics.

axis.value: Tristana looks for all-ins, using burst to secure kills rather than relying on poke.

winCondition.value: Tristana wins fights by positioning well, recognizing power spikes, and using her resets.

spikes.why: Tristana’s Attack Range increases, letting her fire from farther away.

bait.why: After Tristana spends Rocket Jump, she must wait for its cooldown before using it to move again.

mistakes.value: Tristana risks dying when she jumps forward at low health.
